problem: n = 1 mol of an ideal monatomic gas at T1 = 300 K and P1 = 400 kPa is thermally insulated and expands against a constant external pressure P_ext = 100 kPa until it reaches equilibrium. Find the final temperature T2.
common_llm_failure: Applies the reversible adiabatic relation T2 = T1 (P2/P1)^((gamma-1)/gamma) (about 172 K) instead of the first-law result.
